content.user_title: Transcribe Recordings and Search Local Dictations
content.value_statement: Recordings and past dictations can be difficult to review for important details. This skill uses Yap MCP for local transcription and dictation search, then organizes text into notes, summaries, or action items.
actual_capabilities: Request recording paths and call transcribe_audio, with optional timestamps for longer recordings.
Turn transcription results into clean transcripts, summaries, meeting notes, or translations.
Extract decisions, action items, and timestamped quotes while marking uncertain words.
Search local Yap dictation history using keywords and a time window.
Process multiple recordings sequentially and organize results by filename.
Summarize long recordings by timestamped section before producing an overall summary.
limitations: Requires a connected Yap MCP server; this skill contains instructions, not the transcription engine.
First use may require a speech model download of about 670 MB.
The instructions describe automatic detection for 25 European languages, but do not list supported media formats.
Local processing is claimed for Yap transcription; this skill does not establish how the host assistant handles returned text.

use_cases.title: Prepare meeting notes
use_cases.description: Turn a meeting recording into decisions and action items, including owners and dates only when stated.

use_cases.title: Review interview recordings
use_cases.description: Create timestamped transcripts and extract faithful quotes, marking unclear names or numbers.

use_cases.title: Find earlier dictated ideas
use_cases.description: Search Yap dictation history by distinctive words and date range to retrieve relevant passages.

prompt_templates.title: Transcribe a voice memo
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe the recording at [absolute file path]. Keep the original language and mark words you cannot identify confidently.

prompt_templates.title: Create meeting notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe [absolute file path] with timestamps. Produce meeting notes with decisions and action items. Include owners and dates only when stated.

prompt_templates.title: Find a past dictation
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Yap dictation history for [distinctive words] within the past [number] days. If nothing matches, widen the window and report the search scope.

prompt_templates.title: Review several long recordings
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe these recordings one at a time: [absolute file paths]. Group results by filename. Summarize timestamped sections, then provide an overall summary per file.

output_examples.input: Create notes from a sample recording saying: 'We chose the pilot plan. Maya will send the draft on Friday.'
output: Decision: Proceed with the pilot plan.
Action item: Maya will send the draft.
Due date: Friday; no calendar date stated.

output_examples.input: Transcribe a sample memo saying: 'Book a room for Tuesday. The budget is [unclear].'
output_examples.output: Book a room for Tuesday. The budget is [unclear].

best_practices: Provide a clear recording path and request timestamps when you need to revisit specific passages.
Review unclear words, names, numbers, and quoted passages against the original recording.
Use distinctive keywords and a focused date range when searching dictation history.
anti_patterns: Do not replace unavailable local transcription with a cloud service without the user's authorization.
Do not invent names, numbers, action owners, or deadlines that the recording does not establish.
Do not assume local speech recognition means the host assistant processes returned text entirely offline.

faq.question: What must be installed before using this skill?
faq.answer: A Yap MCP server must be connected. The skill provides workflow instructions and does not include the server or speech model.

faq.question: Does the recording stay on my computer?
faq.answer: The instructions state that Yap transcribes locally without uploading audio. They do not verify how your assistant provider handles returned transcripts.

faq.question: Why might the first transcription take longer?
faq.answer: The speech model may need a one-time download of about 670 MB. The instructions recommend retrying the tool after about one minute.

faq.question: Which languages and file formats are supported?
faq.answer: The instructions describe automatic detection for 25 European languages. They do not enumerate languages or supported audio and video formats.

faq.question: Can it find something I dictated earlier?
faq.answer: Yes, through read-only searches of local Yap dictation history using distinctive words and a time window.

faq.question: Can it produce summaries instead of transcripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs the assistant to create summaries, meeting notes, action items, timestamped quotes, or translations from transcription results.
